levels.name: Schema / Tool Selection
levels.description: Select correct Emerald tool and produce valid proposal conforming to Zod schema without code mutation.

levels.name: Locate Relevant Code
levels.description: Identify exact file and relevant function/region containing a specified defect without code mutation.

levels.name: Explain Local Bug
levels.description: Produce a concise, technically correct diagnosis of a known bug grounded in observed source without mutation.

levels.name: One-Line Repair
levels.description: Perform exactly one minimal local line change passing clean-room dual-gate verification and fourfold completion.

levels.name: Small Single-File Repair
levels.description: Repair a small defect requiring 2-5 related edits in one file within bounded scope passing clean-room verification.

levels.name: Multi-Function Single-File Repair
levels.description: Repair a defect involving multiple interacting functions within the same source file passing clean-room verification.

levels.name: Small Multi-File Semantic Repair
levels.description: Repair a defect requiring coordinated changes across 2-3 source files preserving cross-file contracts.

levels.name: Full SWE Task
levels.description: Full repository-scale SWE-bench Verified-compatible defect repair under frozen Phase 42 cohort conditions.
